title: Chic Scottsdale Apts 1-4|FashionSquare|OldTown
description: Welcome to your Old Town Scottsdale gem! This 4-Plex offers an unforgettable stay. Minutes from Scottsdale Fashion District, enjoy dining, entertainment, views, and hiking. Each 2-bed unit (1000ft²) features remodeled interiors with ceramic tiles, wood plank floors, modern white kitchens, and tiled bathrooms. Shared amenities include BBQ, turf grass, and coin laundry. Experience Scottsdale living in this remarkable property. Enjoy your stay and make memories in your new home.
